attributes.dumping: throwing ballast is the only way to make real speed on the plain. The shortfall is owed at the far-rim weighbridge at the Assembly's price, by the master personally, not the firm.
attributes.form: pressed blocks, forty pounds each, stacked low between the axles
attributes.on_the_tamm_line: two hundred and twelve blocks at loading
attributes.purpose: ballast first, cargo second — a light wagon slides on crust in a crosswind and a sliding wagon takes the string with it
attributes.telltale: a dumped block leaves a white scar on the crust that the glare finds for about a week — dumping is visible from behind you
attributes.value: second-grade salt, assayed and priced by the Salt Assembly at both rims

name: Ballast Salt
summary: Pressed blocks of second-grade salt, forty pounds each, stacked low between the axles to keep a wagon from walking on the crust in a crosswind. It is cargo and it is also the thing you throw away to go faster, so every decision to dump it is a decision about who you are trying to reach and what you are willing to owe the Assembly for it. A caravan that arrives light has a story to tell at the weighbridge, and the weighbridge has heard them all.
